bio.text: Maria Elvira Salazar represents Florida's 27th Congressional District and serves on the House Foreign Affairs and Small Business committees.
Before Congress she was a Spanish-language television journalist, and her office says she is a five-time Emmy Award-winning journalist.

Born in Miami's Little Havana, she holds a bachelor's degree in communications from the University of Miami and a master's in public administration from Harvard University's Kennedy School; she lives in Coral Gables.
